title: Weavers Paradise
description: Mod about expressing yourself through clothing
body:
# Weavers Paradise
Weavers Paradise adds a complete textile crafting cycle to Minecraft: spin raw materials into thread, weave fabrics, craft wearable clothing, then customize it all with an advanced dye system offering dozens of unique visual effects.

This mod is actively developed - feedback is always welcome: [GitHub Issues / Feature Requests](https://github.com/Vortianski/Weavers-Paradise/issues)

## Features
### Survival Compatibility
Clothing isn't just cosmetic, it comes with unique enchantments that grant special abilities:
- Faster swimming
- Invisibility to sculk sensors
- Small chance to deflect arrows
- More!

> All abilities can be disabled via config for a more balanced survival experience

### Unique Clothing
Weavers Paradise adds unique clothing items that can be customized in millions of ways using:
- Custom Dyes - from dynamic color-shifting to entirely custom rendering effects
- Stencils - combine dyes in creative ways for truly unique looks

> And not just that, sometimes in dungeon chests you can find a rare Cosplay Armor with popular and recognizable characters

### Mini-Game Crafting
Ever get bored of same crafting stations where you just wait? Well, this mod adds a unique crafting station that allows you to play a mini-game to determine how good the output items will be
![Clothcrafting MiniGame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a766178192553b23cd88ea64f98b481e6d44d503.png)

## Compatibility 
| Mod     | Versions        | Description |
|---------|-----------------|-------------|
| EMI/JEI | 1.20.1/1.21.1 | Full recipe integration, easily look up any craft |
| Cold Sweat & Legendary Survival Overhaul | 1.20.1/1.21.1 | Clothing helps regulate body temperatur |
| Patchouli | 1.20.1/1.21.1 | Guidebook helps you navigate progression |
| Iris Shaders | 1.21.1 | Supported on newer versions. Oculus and others are actively being tested |
